Where passion meets opportunity

The best of your adventures is the one you have yet to sail!

Your Purpose

The Shore Excursions Fleet Supervisor oversees all aspects of Shore Excursions on board MSC Fleet and Is responsible and accountable for driving sales through the effective coaching of the Shore Excursions teams in areas such as profit growth, expense control, product training, staff development and customer service. The goal is to ensure compliance with corporate standards, enhance operational excellence, maximize revenue performance, and improve customer satisfaction scores.

Your Impact

- Monitor and supervise the performance of the assigned ships to achieve Company's assigned targets.

- Support the onboard team to achieve maximum revenue and Guests' Satisfaction

- Ensure application/implementation of company standard and procedures

- Coach and train onboard teams ensuring active team participation

- Audit safety procedures in place with our Tour Operators

Your Journey so far

- At least 4 years of experience in the role of onboard Shorex Manager

- Fluent in English (minimum B2) and any additional language is a plus

- Computer proficiency with the MS Office Package

- Knowledge of onboard booking systems is an advantage

- Analytical skills

- Experience in training and people development

- Strong Interpersonal and Communication skills

- This is a crew contract involving a long period of travel on board our ships and our offices

The Fleet Supervisor’s activities are supervised and coordinated by the Corporate Team, to whom they report all actions, ideas, and implementations, while also providing relevant analyses to monitor and enhance the results required by the Company.

Your Essentials

Hold a valid passport

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

Il tuo scopo

L'F&B Service Manager è un ruolo strategico di base responsabile per la gestione, la supervisione e la guida di tutte le operazioni di servizio Food & Beverage in tutta la flotta. Questo ruolo garantisce l'eccellenza del servizio, la coerenza nell'esperienza degli ospiti e l'allineamento con gli standard aziendali. Essendo il principale collegamento tra i team di bordo e la leadership aziendale, il Manager di F&B Service guida qualità, innovazione, conformità e sviluppo di talenti in tutte le operazioni F&B. Questo ruolo riporta direttamente al Vice Presidente della F&B.

Il tuo impatto

Operazioni e standard strategici

- Definire, implementare e mantenere standard di servizio F&B a livello di flotta e best practice.

- Sviluppare e supervisionare iniziative strategiche per migliorare l'esperienza degli ospiti e l'efficienza operativa in tutte le navi.

- Coordinare i team di bordo per garantire il rispetto delle politiche aziendali, delle procedure e degli standard di marca.

- Condurre audit remoti, recensioni operative e valutazioni per mantenere l'eccellenza dei servizi.

Esperienza e garanzia di qualità

- Monitorare la soddisfazione degli ospiti e le metriche delle prestazioni F&B, analizzare le tendenze e raccomandare miglioramenti.

- Collabora con i team culinari e bevande per innovare ed elevare l'offerta F&B a bordo.

- Assicurare l'allineamento con i protocolli di salute, sicurezza e igiene globali attraverso i programmi aziendali.

Sviluppo della formazione e della leadership

- Progettare e supervisionare i programmi di formazione per i team F&B per garantire la coerenza con la filosofia di servizio del marchio.

- Mentor e sviluppare i leader di bordo F&B per sostenere la progressione di carriera e la pianificazione di successione.

Risorse umane e supervisione della leadership

- Collaborare con le risorse umane su recensioni, promozioni, rotazioni e percorsi di carriera per il personale F&B.

- Promuovere una cultura ad alte prestazioni radicata nel riconoscimento, nello sviluppo e nell'equità.

Supporto flotta e coordinamento centrale

- Servire come principale collegamento aziendale per tutti i servizi F&B in tutta la flotta.

- Coordinate pianificazione delle attrezzature F&B, sourcing dei materiali e integrazione degli standard del marchio.

- Compili e analizza report operativi, riassunti di viaggio e metriche di performance per la leadership aziendale.

- Partecipare a riunioni chiave di bordo da remoto o di persona come richiesto.

Supervisione finanziaria

- Sostenere la sostenibilità finanziaria e la redditività delle operazioni F&B in tutta la flotta.

- Implementare programmi di miglioramento continuo per raggiungere obiettivi operativi e finanziari.

- supervisionare il controllo dei costi, la pianificazione dell'inventario e l'assegnazione delle risorse in coordinamento con i team di bordo.

Il tuo viaggio finora

- Minimo 15 anni in alta gamma Food & Beverage operazioni.

- Esperienza comprovata nella supervisione operativa multi-sito.

I tuoi essenziali

Leadership e comunicazione

- Leader strategico e dinamico con esperienza nella gestione di team multiculturali.

- Eccellente capacità di comunicazione, fluente in inglese; lingue aggiuntive un bene.

Conoscenza tecnica e operativa

- Proficiente in Microsoft Office e sistemi specifici per il settore.

- Forte comprensione dei protocolli HR, dei regolamenti del lavoro e degli standard di conformità.

- Conoscenza esperta delle operazioni F&B, della programmazione delle bevande e degli standard di ospitalità di lusso.

Competenze professionali

- Pensatore strategico con agilità operativa e forte acume aziendale.

- Risultati guidati, orientati ai dettagli e altamente collaborativi.

- Capace di lavorare in modo trasversale in team aziendali e di bordo.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Your Purpose

The F&B Service Manager is a strategic headquarters-based role responsible for providing leadership, oversight, and guidance for all Food & Beverage service operations across the fleet. This role ensures service excellence, consistency in guest experience, and alignment with corporate standards. Acting as the primary liaison between shipboard teams and corporate leadership, the Manager of F&B Service drives quality, innovation, compliance, and talent development across all F&B operations. This role reports directly to the Vice President of F&B.

Your Impact

Strategic Operations & Standards

- Define, implement, and maintain fleet-wide F&B service standards and best practices.

- Develop and oversee strategic initiatives to enhance guest experience and operational efficiency across all vessels.

- Coordinate with shipboard teams to ensure compliance with corporate policies, procedures, and brand standards.

- Conduct remote audits, operational reviews, and assessments to maintain service excellence.

Guest Experience & Quality Assurance

- Monitor guest satisfaction and F&B performance metrics, analyze trends, and recommend improvements.

- Collaborate with culinary and beverage teams to innovate and elevate the onboard F&B offering.

- Ensure alignment with global health, safety, and hygiene protocols through corporate-led programs.

Training & Leadership Development

- Design and oversee training programs for F&B teams to ensure consistency with the brand’s service philosophy.

- Mentor and develop shipboard F&B leaders to support career progression and succession planning.

Human Resources & Leadership Oversight

- Collaborate with HR on performance reviews, promotions, rotations, and career pathing for F&B personnel.

- Promote a high-performance culture rooted in recognition, development, and fairness.

Fleet Support & Headquarters Coordination

- Serve as the principal corporate liaison for all F&B service matters across the fleet.

- Coordinate F&B equipment planning, material sourcing, and integration of brand standards.

- Compile and analyze operational reports, voyage summaries, and performance metrics for corporate leadership.

- Participate in key shipboard meetings remotely or in person as required.

Financial Oversight

- Support financial sustainability and profitability of F&B operations across the fleet.

- Implement continuous improvement programs to achieve operational and financial targets.

- Oversee cost control, inventory planning, and resource allocation in coordination with shipboard teams.

Your Journey so far

- Minimum 15 years in high-end Food & Beverage operations.

- At least 5 years in senior leadership roles within luxury hospitality or cruise operations.

- Proven experience in multi-site operational oversight.

Your Essentials

Leadership & Communication

- Strategic, dynamic leader with experience managing multicultural teams.

- Excellent communication skills, fluent in English; additional languages an asset.

Technical & Operational Knowledge

- Proficient in Microsoft Office and industry-specific systems.

- Strong understanding of HR protocols, labor regulations, and compliance standards.

- Expert knowledge of F&B operations, beverage programming, and luxury hospitality standards.

Professional Competencies

- Strategic thinker with operational agility and strong business acumen.

- Results-driven, detail-oriented, and highly collaborative.

- Capable of working cross-functionally across corporate and shipboard teams.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

Diese Rolle berichtet direkt an den Vizepräsidenten der F&B.

Strategische Operationen & Standards

- F&B-Service-Standards und bewährte Praktiken definieren, umsetzen und pflegen.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Votre but

Le gestionnaire des services F&B est un responsable stratégique de l'administration centrale qui assure le leadership, la surveillance et l'orientation de toutes les activités des services d'alimentation et de boissons dans l'ensemble de la flotte. Ce rôle assure l'excellence du service, l'uniformité de l'expérience des invités et l'harmonisation avec les normes ministérielles. En tant que principale liaison entre les équipes de bord et le leadership de l'entreprise, le gestionnaire du Service F&B favorise la qualité, l'innovation, la conformité et le développement des talents dans toutes les opérations de F&B. Ce rôle relève directement du vice-président de F&B.

Votre impact

Opérations stratégiques et normes

- Définir, mettre en oeuvre et maintenir des normes de service et des pratiques exemplaires à l'échelle de la flotte.

- Élaborer et superviser des initiatives stratégiques pour améliorer l'expérience des invités et l'efficacité opérationnelle de tous les navires.

- Coordonner avec les équipes de bord pour assurer le respect des politiques, des procédures et des normes de marque.

- Effectuer des vérifications à distance, des examens opérationnels et des évaluations pour maintenir l'excellence du service.

Expérience des invités et assurance qualité

- Surveiller la satisfaction des clients et les mesures du rendement des F et B, analyser les tendances et recommander des améliorations.

- Collaborer avec des équipes culinaires et de boissons pour innover et élever l'offre de F&B à bord.

- Assurer l'harmonisation avec les protocoles mondiaux de santé, de sécurité et d'hygiène au moyen de programmes dirigés par l'entreprise.

Formation et perfectionnement en leadership

- Concevoir et superviser des programmes de formation pour les équipes F&B afin d'assurer la cohérence avec la philosophie de service de la marque.

- Mentor et former des chefs de F&B à bord des navires pour appuyer l'avancement professionnel et la planification de la relève.

Surveillance des ressources humaines et du leadership

- Collaborer avec les RH aux examens du rendement, aux promotions, aux rotations et à l'orientation de carrière du personnel des F&B.

- Promouvoir une culture de haute performance ancrée dans la reconnaissance, le développement et l'équité.

Soutien de la flotte et coordination du quartier général

- Servir de principale liaison ministérielle pour toutes les questions relatives aux services F&B dans l'ensemble de la flotte.

- Coordonner la planification de l'équipement F&B, l'approvisionnement en matériel et l'intégration des normes de marque.

- Compiler et analyser les rapports opérationnels, les résumés de voyage et les indicateurs de rendement pour le leadership ministériel.

- Participer à des réunions clés à distance ou en personne au besoin.

Contrôle financier

- Soutenir la viabilité financière et la rentabilité des activités de F&B dans l'ensemble de la flotte.

- Mettre en oeuvre des programmes d'amélioration continue pour atteindre les objectifs opérationnels et financiers.

- Surveiller le contrôle des coûts, la planification des stocks et l'affectation des ressources en coordination avec les équipes de bord.

Votre voyage jusqu'à présent

- Au moins 15 ans dans les exploitations haut de gamme d'aliments et de boissons.

- Au moins 5 ans à des postes de direction dans l'hôtellerie de luxe ou les opérations de croisière.

- Expérience éprouvée en matière de surveillance opérationnelle sur plusieurs sites.

Your Purpose

The Senior Digital Acquisition Manager will be responsible for leading the digital marketing strategy across all MSC Cruises markets, with a focus on driving direct sales through digital advertising levers, setting and achieving KPIs, and developing innovative digital campaigns across multiple channels. The successful candidate will have a proven track record in performance marketing and digital sales development at a positive ROAS, along with strong expertise in digital advertising campaign strategy, paid media planning and implementation, and team leadership. Additionally, the role will involve developing affiliation and partnership programs as part of an integrated digital engagement strategy to broaden reach, drive qualified traffic, and support long-term customer value.

Your Impact

• Develop and maintain strong relationships with MSC stakeholders across various markets, with a deep understanding of their business needs, challenges, and opportunities—while balancing the global objectives set by headquarters.

• Set and achieve KPIs for online sales through digital advertising levers, ensuring the media agency delivers against targets and contractual obligations.

• Lead internal meetings, QBRs, and annual reviews by providing strategic insights and recommendations based on campaign performance, website analytics, market trends, and the competitive landscape.

• Plan and implement innovative performance marketing campaigns across Paid Search, Display, Social, Native, Digital Audio, and Video channels—tailored to business goals and market dynamics.

• Collaborate with internal teams—including Creative, Social Media, Data & Analytics, SEO, Content, Product, and agency partners—to ensure the timely delivery of high-quality assets aligned with annual digital sales targets.

• Identify and pursue opportunities to enhance revenue streams through existing and new digital strategies, while improving campaign ROAS and experimenting with innovations in the adtech and martech ecosystem.

• Develop and manage lead generation strategies, ensuring effective customer acquisition flows and nurturing tactics are in place across all paid media touchpoints.

• Maintain oversight of account resourcing and profitability to ensure HQ and local markets are managed efficiently and profitably.

• Serve as the main escalation point for concerns raised by internal teams or local market stakeholders.

• Continuously review and optimize operational workflows, proposing and implementing process improvements where relevant.

• Collaborate with country and HQ stakeholders to prepare and manage the annual digital marketing budget, aligned with MSC Cruises’ B2C revenue goals.

• Lead and optimize affiliate and partnership programs to drive qualified traffic and conversions, ensuring alignment with digital acquisition strategy and performance goals.

• Manage key partners and co-branded initiatives, coordinating with internal teams to ensure seamless execution and tracking.

• 7+ years of experience in a similar role.
• Hands-on experience with analytics and ad server tools such as GA4, Adobe Analytics, Campaign Manager and their relevant reporting frameworks.
• Proven experience in managing, mentoring, and upskilling team members.
• Past experience in lead generation strategy and execution is a strong plus.
• Solid experience in budget ownership and cost control.

Your Essentials

• Fluent in English (additional languages are a plus).
• Strong analytical skills and the ability to leverage data for informed decision-making.
• Proven track record of driving direct sales growth and improving ROAS through high-performing digital advertising campaigns.
• Passion for digital marketing, performance media, and innovative digital solutions.
• Deep knowledge of Google and Meta ad platforms, including setup auditing, implementation, and performance analysis with actionable insights.
• Excellent organizational, project management, and problem-solving skills.
• Proficient in Microsoft Office and data visualization tools such as Datorama.
• Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams and external partners.
• Ability to identify trends in data and transform insights into actionable strategic recommendations.
• Self-starter with the ability to work independently and take initiative.
• Confident, articulate presenter—comfortable engaging with senior stakeholders and internal teams.
• Strong strategic thinking, capable of acting as a ‘Trusted Advisor’ to senior leadership.
• High attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
• Positive attitude, proactive mindset, and a drive to embrace new challenges.
• Knowledge of affiliate platforms such as Awin, Kwanko, and similar tools. Strong network of industry contacts to initiate partnership opportunities and brand collaborations.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Your Purpose

Lead Onboard Casino Technical teams, ensuring smooth operations, maintaining high standards of service, and maximising revenue generation. As a Casino Slot and Technical Operations Manager, you will be responsible for monitoring slot machine performance, analysing gaming data, and implementing strategies to enhance player satisfaction and profitability. Your role will involve regular inspections and maintenance scheduling to ensure all slot machines are functioning correctly and efficiently. You will also be responsible for managing inventory, ordering new equipment, and coordinating installations and upgrades. You will be expected to stay updated on industry trends and emerging technologies, proactively adapting operations to maintain compliance and competitive advantage.

Your Impact

• Oversee all technical projects and actively participate in their implementation. Maintain an excellent line of communication with the shore and ship technical department to ensure all casino projects are deployed according to schedule and comply to the company’s technical and safety standards.
• Assist with budgeting, forecasting and revenue analysis.
• Manage budgets, control costs, and optimise resource allocation.
• Support and guide onboard Casino management team on each vessel through constant communication and regular ship operational visits. Discuss any areas of concern specific to the Operation and brand specific product, and similarly address points of commendation.
• Provide accurate and objective assessment of onboard Casino operations and personnel.
• Revenue analysis, identifying trends with the ability to create structured solutions to increase or enhance revenue streams. Explore new ways of increasing existing revenue and /or improving current working practices, whilst at the same time maintaining a high technical and security standard onboard our ships.
• Isolate areas falling below standard with members of the Casino Shipboard management team.
• Training of all management teams in Slot Revenue, Security and Surveillance.
• Confirm that security measures meet minimum requirements.
• Provide troubleshooting support and advice via email to shipboard technical teams.
• Assess, evaluate and review data for organizing projects and/or providing directions on activities, tasks or processes in accordance with company guidelines.

Your Journey so far

• Minimum 5 years of experience in casino slot operations management.
• Previous experience working on a cruise ship is mandatory.

Your Essentials

• Strong knowledge of gaming regulations and compliance requirements.
• Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
• Proficiency in analysing gaming data and financial reports.
• Ability to manage budgets, control costs, and optimize resources.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Il tuo scopo

Unisciti a MSC Crociere per un entusiasmante stage focalizzato su analisi, monitoraggio delle prestazioni e generazione di informazioni in due aree strategiche: Customer Journey e il nostro miglior programma.

Questo ruolo è ideale per qualcuno appassionato di analisi dei dati, generazione di insight e creazione di dashboard, con un forte interesse a migliorare l'esperienza dei dipendenti e degli ospiti attraverso un impatto misurabile.

Sosterrai lo sviluppo di analisi strutturate e meccanismi di follow-up, lavorando a stretto contatto con il reparto Customer Journey e HR. Il ruolo fornisce un'esposizione pratica sia agli analytics orientati agli ospiti che ai dipendenti.

Il tuo impatto

Viaggio dei clienti:

- Sostenere le analisi del Customer Journey ricorrenti, incluse le recensioni basate su tela, le analisi della nave di mezza stagione e i responsabili dei comitati.

- Contribuire a analisi approfondite ad hoc su argomenti specifici, segmenti ospiti, nazionalità o navi, in base alle richieste di business e gestione.

- Preparare estrazioni di dati, grafici, tabelle e uscite analitiche di primo livello utilizzando modelli standardizzati.

- Mantenere i tracker di analisi del Customer Journey, assicurando la documentazione corretta, il controllo della versione e il monitoraggio dei piani di azione.

- Supporta analisi e aggiornamenti di follow-up dopo i piloti, modifiche operative o feedback di gestione.

- Assicurare l'accuratezza dei dati, la consistenza e l'allineamento attraverso il Customer Journey consegnabili e reporting.

Il nostro programma BEST:

- Sostenere lo sviluppo, la manutenzione e il monitoraggio dei framework KPI per il nostro programma BEST.

Lavorando in parallelo con lo sviluppo, la costruzione e l'esperienza degli ospiti, il direttore delle operazioni garantisce che i beni sono operabili dal design, completamente pronti all'apertura e in modo sostenibile, sicuro e redditizio in seguito. Il vostro impatto 1. Leadership operativa Attraverso il ciclo di vita delle risorse proprie responsabilità operativa end-to-end dalla pre-apertura attraverso operazioni dal vivo. Definire la visione operativa a lungo termine, KPI e standard di servizio. Garantire continuità di progettazione, cultura e sistemi dalla fase di progetto alle operazioni a stato costante. 2. Pre-apertura e mobilitazione (Parallel to Construction) Guidare il programma di disponibilità operativa allineato con pietre miliari di costruzione. In coordinamento con Corporate Guest Services (F&B, HK, Entertainment ecc.), definisce le esigenze di Procurements e implementarlo. FFE/OWS. Decisioni di progettazione di influenza per garantire efficienza operativa, sicurezza e manutenbilità. Stabilire strutture operative, SOP e governance ben prima dell'apertura. Gestire gli abbonamenti dalla costruzione alle operazioni, compresi i fatturato phased. Per ogni progetto, identificare le necessità del personale e - in combinazione con le risorse umane- garantire la capacità operativa di nuovi asset. Stabilire programmi di formazione per la disponibilità operativa. 3. Post-Opening Operations Management Operazioni giornaliere dirette in tutti i dipartimenti (ospitalità, F&B, vendita al dettaglio, attrazioni, marine, sicurezza, manutenzione, servizi ospiti). Assicurare la consegna di esperienze, sicurezza, qualità dei servizi e standard di marca. Guidare la stabilità operativa durante le fasi di rampa e maturità. Condurre iniziative di miglioramento continuo attraverso il bene. 4. Forza di lavoro, formazione e cultura costruire, condurre e mantenere una forza lavoro multinazionale ad alto rendimento. Mantenere ed evolvere i programmi di formazione post-apertura. Integra una cultura orientata alla sicurezza e alle prestazioni. 5. Financial & Commercial Performance Own operativo P&L, controlli dei costi e metriche di produttività. Gestisci bilanci operativi, capex pianificazione e riserve del ciclo di vita. Collaborare con i team commerciali per ottimizzare i ricavi (F&B, retail, esperienze, escursioni a riva dove applicabile). 6. Compliance, Safety & Risk Management Assicurare il rispetto costante di tutti gli standard normativi, marittimi, sanitari, di sicurezza e ambientali. Guidare la preparazione di emergenza, la gestione delle crisi e la pianificazione della continuità aziendale. Servire come responsabile per gli audit e le ispezioni. Il vostro viaggio finora - 15+ anni senior operazioni leadership in ospitalità, destinazioni da crociera, resort, porti, parchi a tema o grandi attività di ospitalità. - Proprietà dimostrata delle operazioni pre-apertura e a lungo termine. - Forte background che lavora insieme a team di sviluppo, costruzione e servizi tecnici. - Esperienza in ambienti caraibici o isolati fortemente preferito. descriptionByLocale.en: Your Purpose The Director of Operations is accountable for the design, mobilization, opening and ongoing operation of large-scale cruise and hospitality infrastructure assets. The role ensures continuity from development through steady-state operations, acting as the operational owner from early construction phases through long-term performance. Working in parallel with Development, Construction and Guest Experience, the Director of Operations guarantees that assets are operable by design, fully ready at opening, and sustainably efficient, safe and profitable thereafter. Your Impact 1. Operational Leadership Across the Asset Lifecycle Own end-to-end operational responsibility from pre-opening through live operations. Define the long-term operating vision, KPIs and service standards. Ensure continuity of design, culture and systems from project phase into steady-state operations. 2. Pre-Opening & Mobilization (Parallel to Construction) Lead the operational readiness program aligned with construction milestones. In coordination with Corporate Guest Services (F&B, HK, Entertainment etc.), define Procurements needs and implement it. FFE/OWS. Influence design decisions to ensure operational efficiency, safety and maintainability. Establish operating structures, SOPs and governance well ahead of opening. Manage handovers from construction to operations, including phased turnovers. For each project, identify personnel need and -in conjunction with HR- ensure the operational ability of new assets. Establish Training Programs for operational readiness. 3. Post-Opening Operations Management Direct daily operations across all departments (hospitality, F&B, retail, attractions, marine, security, maintenance, guest services). Ensure delivery of guest experience, safety, service quality and brand standards. Drive operational stability during ramp-up and maturity phases. Lead continuous improvement initiatives across the asset. 4. Workforce, Training & Culture Build, lead and retain a high-performing, multi-national workforce. Maintain and evolve training programs post-opening. Embed a safety-first, service-oriented and performance-driven culture. 5. Financial & Commercial Performance Own operational P&L, cost controls and productivity metrics. Manage operating budgets, capex planning and lifecycle reserves. Collaborate with commercial teams to optimize revenue (F&B, retail, experiences, shore excursions where applicable). 6. Compliance, Safety & Risk Management Ensure ongoing compliance with all regulatory, maritime, health, safety and environmental standards. Lead emergency preparedness, crisis management and business continuity planning. Serve as the accountable executive for audits and inspections. Your Journey so far - 15+ years senior operations leadership in hospitality, cruise destinations, resorts, ports, theme parks or large hospitality assets. - Demonstrated ownership of both pre-opening and long-term operations. - Strong background working alongside development, construction and technical services teams. - Experience in Caribbean or island environments strongly preferred. Your Essentials - Operational readiness & lifecycle operations - Large-scale workforce leadership - Financial & P&L accountability - Asset lifecycle & maintenance management - Multi-operator and concession management Our commitment We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet. Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

descriptionByLocale.en:
Where passion meets opportunity Discover your journey into the extraordinary. Your Purpose Explora Journeys is a vibrant, cosmopolitan, European luxury brand, imagined in the heart of Swiss hospitality in Geneva. Leveraging our parent company MSC Group’s hundreds of years of maritime expertise, our fleet of six luxury ships (four currently in the pipeline) are being built and designed in a totally different and unique way that will transform and redefine the cruise experience, creating a category of its own, appealing to the next generation of luxury travellers. The CRM Director – Insights, Customer Lifecycle & Marketing Automation leads the strategy and activation of data-driven customer engagement programs to inform the business and support commercial growth, loyalty and lifetime value. The role acts as business lead for lifecycle marketing and marketing automation, working in close partnership with Commercial, Digital, IT, Data and Legal teams to ensure scalable, compliant and high-performing customer communications. He/ She leads the customer’s insights area recommending how to approach the brand evolution assessment. The role is based in Geneva, Switzerland. Your Impact 1. Lifecycle Strategy & Co-Ownership
• Lead the definition of the global customer lifecycle strategy organizing the customer journey vision with Commercial, Digital and Guest Experience teams.
• Translate lifecycle ambition into structured activation roadmaps across owned marketing automation channels.
• Define lifecycle design principles, segmentation logic and engagement frameworks aligned with brand and commercial objectives.
• Ensure cross-functional alignment between customer experience, commercial priorities and lifecycle communications. 2. Journey Activation & Channel Governance
• Lead automated journey orchestration primarily across owned CRM channels
• Establish governance for segmentation, personalization and campaign standards.
• Coordinate with other channel owners (e.g., Media, Social, Digital) to ensure journey consistency.
• Drive structured adoption of personalization and audience activation tools. 3. Platform Business Ownership
• Act as business product owner of marketing automation platforms (e.g., Salesforce Marketing Cloud).
• Define functional requirements, prioritization and business roadmap.
• Partner with IT, as technical owner, for architecture, integrations, security and scalability.
• Ensure operational excellence of automations, data flows and activation processes. 4. Data Governance & Compliance
• Define lifecycle communication standards in alignment with Legal and IT.
• Ensure consent management and subscription governance frameworks are operationalized within marketing automation tools.
• Support privacy-by-design principles across activation use cases. 5. Commercial Impact & Performance
• Define CRM contribution metrics and dashboards.
• Monitor engagement, retention and revenue influence.
• Provide optimization roadmaps to senior leadership. 6. Lead the development of a customer insights framework, leveraging CRM data, external ad hoc research to inform brand health evolution. Translate customer understanding into actionable growth opportunities. Partner with Guest Experience teams, Marketing and Commercial teams to design and prioritize customer research initiatives, including satisfaction tracking, journey analysis, loyalty drivers, brand tracking,etc. 7. Team & Capability Building
• Build a high-performing marketing CRM team.
• Elevate internal understanding of marketing automation capabilities and limitations.
• Drive adoption and maturity of audience strategy and segmentation practices. Your Journey so far
• 15+ years of experience in CRM, customer lifecycle management, marketing automation or customer data roles, ideally in global and local environments.
• Proven experience driving customer acquisition, engagement, loyalty and retention through CRM at scale.
• Proven experience designing and managing complex customer journeys across multiple channels, markets and touchpoints, including long consideration and purchase cycles
• Deep understanding of CRM platforms, marketing automation tools and data-driven marketing,
• Solid knowledge on global standards for data capture, consent management, governance, and enrichment
• Strong analytical mindset with experience translating CRM data into actionable insights. Experience leading customer insights initiatives such as segmentation studies, loyalty drivers, NPS/satisfaction research or journey diagnostics.
• Proven people manager, able to build, structure and develop teams to deliver measurable business outcomes.
• Strong track record of working hands-on while leading strategically, especially in complex or fast-growth environments.
• Experience managing agencies and external partners.
• Prior experience in luxury, premium or high-end consumer brands strongly preferred as well as Travel & hospitality Your Essentials
• Strategic, customer-centric and commercially minded leader.
• Highly analytical, data-driven and comfortable translating insights into action.
• Technically savvy, with the ability to bridge business, data and technology teams.
• Structured, detail-oriented and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
• Outstanding collaboration and influencing skills, with proven ability to operate in a matrix organization.
